ultimates.fantasy: A high-speed unarmed rush ends in the Amazon's signature flying kick.
A sequence of elite kicks launches a giant sonic crescent through the lane.
A vertical sequence of original-style bombs erases a combat lane.
A giant beam tracks the dominant threat and sweeps the lane once.
The machine gun becomes a sustained wall of lead with no reload break.
A fan of intelligent missiles hunts every major threat.
A sustained blue-dragon breath freezes the entire forward lane.
Green breath floods a large zone with corrosive dragon fire.
A circular firestorm erupts from the red dragon, then surges forward.
Six deliberate pistol shots snap between the highest-priority targets.
The Tommy Gun sweeps three lanes with sustained fire.
Guru rises within a spiritual mandala and releases layered palm shockwaves that clear space.
An anchored acrobatic projection creates precise firing angles without moving the player body.
Anchored afterimage Hoopers surround the firing lane with rapid SMG crossfire.
Dark sigils connect and collapse into an abyssal strike.
A radiant gate fires prism lances that pierce once and refract across the battlefield.
A spinning chain storm drags minor threats inward and shreds the center.
A giant returning shuriken carves a readable figure-eight through the room.
The Robot unfolds multiple original-style rocket pods and fires a synchronized salvo.
A giant spectral ball ricochets through every major threat before returning.
A mobile blizzard follows the Snow Woman and repeatedly freezes lanes.
A flock of blood bats drains the battlefield and returns as one healing wave.
A colossal scythe crosses the room and returns with the souls it touched.
Jennifer reproduces her original laser attack as a rapid crossing array.
A superhuman punch launches the original giant fireball across the full room.
